reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Antioxidant Sunscreen 40mL
reviews.text: Love the formula. Not too light. Just right. I use it as a base/primer before applying foundation. Works well. I’m waiting for re-stock.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢個配方。唔會太稀，剛剛好。我會用佢做粉底之前嘅底霜／base。效果好好。等緊返貨。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Antioxidant Sunscreen 40mL
reviews.text: first time to purchase this product. the bottle is hard to squeeze but happy with the quality. easy to apply on the skin.
reviews.zh: 第一次買呢款產品。枝嘢幾難唧，但質素令我滿意。搽上面好容易推開。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Antioxidant Sunscreen 40mL
reviews.text: Good texture, light weight formula, many active ingredients and antioxidant components, however i am not a fan of the packaging, it is hard to control the amount of product you will be using.
reviews.zh: 質地好，配方輕盈，有好多活性成分同抗氧化成分，不過我就唔係好鍾意個包裝，比較難控制每次擠出嚟嘅分量。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Antioxidant Sunscreen 40mL
reviews.text: Tui ở VN nhận hàng 7-10 ngày . Hàng nhận date xa và còn nguyên nhìn rất ưng luôn . Chỉ có điều Thuế hơi caoooo
reviews.zh: 我喺越南收貨要 7 至 10 日。收到嘅貨到期日仲好遠，包裝完好無缺，望落好滿意。只係稅有少少貴呀。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Antioxidant Sunscreen 40mL
reviews.text: It’s very drying and leaves a white residue after blending it. Does not work well with makeup. If you have any dry spots it will dry it out even more, the skin would end up flaky. I noticed a white reside on my hair line. I have dark hair so it’s very noticeable. I don’t recommend this product at all.
reviews.zh: 用落非常乾，推開之後仲留有白色殘留物。配搭化妝品用效果唔好。如果你皮膚有乾燥位置，會愈用愈乾，搞到甩皮。我留意到髮線位有白色殘留物，我頭髮深色所以好明顯。完全唔推介呢款產品。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Antioxidant Sunscreen 40mL
reviews.text:
Been using everyday this week and impressed so far : it absorbs well and sits good under make up
HOWEVER please change the packaging of the bottle, it’s quite difficult to get the formula out so sometimes it’s too much / not enough so sometimes it’s not convenient
reviews.zh:
今個星期日日都有用，到目前為止印象好好：吸收得快，搽完化妝都好貼服
不過麻煩改一改個樽裝，真係好難唧出嚟，所以有時唧太多／有時唔夠，有時都幾唔方便

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Antioxidant Sunscreen 40mL
reviews.text: First of all, it is somewhat difficult to squeeze out the product. I like other somebymi products, so I thought I'd give new sunscreen a try and decided to stick to my old one. It gives horrible what cast on my face and I cannot rub it in on the side, so there's distinct white line and pile on both side of my face and my eyebrows look they've been snowed on!! Will use on my hands or something....
reviews.zh: 首先，個產品有少少難唧出嚟。因為我鍾意 other somebymi 嘅其他產品，所以想試吓新出嘅防曬，點知用完我決定用返舊嗰枝。搽上面塊面泛白好勁，側邊我根本推唔開，所以兩邊面同眉毛位有明顯嘅白色線條同堆積物，望落好似眉毛落晒雪咁！！應該只會搽喺手或者其他位置……

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Antioxidant Sunscreen 40mL
reviews.text: I bought this product but is this sunscreen supposed to make your face look white?? Because mine appears like that unless it’s not meant for me
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢款產品，但係咪防曬應該搽到塊面白晒㗎？？因為我塊面真係變到好白，除非呢款唔啱我用。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
